name: Howard Street Greasers
description: The Howard Street Greasers were a white ethnic gang primarily composed of Polish, Italian, and Irish members active in Chicago's Rogers Park neighborhood during the 1970s. They maintained territory west and south of the Howard Street L tracks and were involved in conflicts with rival gangs seeking to encroach on their turf. They were allied with several other white street gangs of the era.
